coverage: SELECT min(created_at) first_at,max(created_at) last_at,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE llm_operation_id IS NULL) missing_operation_ids FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz
feature_status: SELECT call_type,status,count(*) rows,sum(prompt_tokens) input_tokens,sum(completion_tokens) output_tokens,count(prompt_tokens) input_token_rows,count(completion_tokens) output_token_rows FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
daily: SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS utc_day,call_type,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status NOT LIKE 'skipped%') attempted_rows,count(DISTINCT llm_operation_id) logical_ops,sum(prompt_tokens) input_tokens,sum(completion_tokens) output_tokens FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
provider_status: SELECT provider,model,status,error_reason,count(*) rows,sum(prompt_tokens) input_tokens,sum(completion_tokens) output_tokens FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4
sizes: SELECT call_type,count(*) rows,count(input_chars) input_char_rows,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY input_chars) input_chars_p50,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY input_chars) input_chars_p95,max(input_chars) input_chars_max,percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY prompt_tokens) input_tokens_p50,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY prompt_tokens) input_tokens_p95,percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY completion_tokens) output_tokens_p95 FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND status NOT LIKE 'skipped%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
burst: WITH b AS (SELECT date_trunc('minute',created_at) AS minute_bucket,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status NOT LIKE 'skipped%') attempted_rows,count(DISTINCT llm_operation_id) logical_ops FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1) SELECT max(rows) peak_rows_per_minute,max(attempted_rows) peak_attempted_rows_per_minute,max(logical_ops) peak_logical_ops_per_minute FROM b
fallback: WITH o AS (SELECT llm_operation_id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status NOT LIKE 'skipped%') attempts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='success') successes,count(DISTINCT provider) provider_entries FROM llm_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND llm_operation_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1) SELECT count(*) correlated_ops,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attempts>1) multi_attempt_ops,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attempts>1 AND successes>0) recovered_multi_attempt_ops,count(*) FILTER(WHERE successes=0) no_success_ops,max(attempts) max_attempts FROM o
analysis_outcomes: SELECT analysis_type,status,error_reason,count(*) rows FROM event_ai_analyses WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,2,3
heartbeat_outcomes: SELECT status,count(*) rows FROM market_heartbeats WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1
report_outcomes: SELECT report_type,provider,model,status,count(*) rows FROM market_reports WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4
reuse: SELECT decision_stage,decision_reason,count(*) rows FROM alert_delivery_outcomes WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-12T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND created_at < '2026-10-19T00:00:00Z'::timestamptz AND (decision_reason ILIKE '%reuse%' OR decision_reason ILIKE '%cache%') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
